repository.scope: New untracked gate scripts only; all pre-existing working-tree changes are intentionally excluded.

environment.execution: local macOS host; deterministic symbolic computation; no random seed

mathematics.assertion_tested: A field-independent, zero-free universal spin-2 kernel can preserve linear no slip but cannot reproduce deep-MOND source scaling; scalar curvature-dependent completions introduce a scalar/no-slip source; finite/rational tensor localizations have an unavoidable TT ghost-sign multiplier block; ordinary CTP diagonal matching does not turn that response pair into a second-class Dirac reduction; the direct multiplier attempt to enforce matching erases the driven response equation instead of canonically restoring it.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact SymPy expressions over real positive parameters k, ell, alpha, b and real source rho; complex zero-set query only for exp(z).
mathematics.conventions: Static Fourier convention Box -> -k^2; gamma = Psi/Phi; weak metric potentials use g00=-(1+2 Phi), gij=(1-2 Psi)deltaij; TT test uses one off-diagonal tensor component.
mathematics.inputs: Universal kernel a(Box)=exp(-ell^2 Box); F(R)=R+alpha R^2; localized principal block Lambda^{mn}(Box U_mn-G_mn) with b>0; source-rescaling parameter lambda>0.
mathematics.bounds: The scripts establish only the stated subclasses. They do not decide a nonlinear tensorial, genuinely non-rational doubled-CTP construction.
non_claims: No theorem is asserted for every possible covariant nonlocal action.
No full preferred-frame PPN calculation is asserted for the surviving nonlinear tensorial CTP route.
Retarded boundary data are not treated as a substitute for a demonstrated doubled-CTP phase-space reduction.
